experiences.name: Gwangjang Market Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Seoul's oldest and most famous traditional markets. Sample iconic Korean street foods including bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak gimbap, tteokbokki, and fresh yukhoe (beef tartare). Interact with local vendors and experience the vibrant atmosphere of authentic Korean market culture.

experiences.name: K-Pop & Hallyu Culture Experience in Hongdae
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in Seoul's K-culture hub. Visit K-pop merchandise stores, attend a live busking performance, explore indie music venues, and try a K-pop dance class at one of the many studios in the area. Hongdae is the heartbeat of Korean youth culture and the K-wave movement.

experiences.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Hanbok Experience
experiences.description: Visit the grand Gyeongbokgung Palace, the largest of Seoul's Five Grand Palaces. Rent a traditional Hanbok (Korean dress) from a nearby rental shop and explore the palace grounds for free while wearing it. Watch the ceremonial changing of the royal guard and visit the National Folk Museum of Korea located within the palace grounds.

experiences.name: Incheon Chinatown & Songwol-dong Fairy Tale Village Walk
experiences.description: Since you're based near Bupyeong-gu in Incheon, explore the nearby Incheon Chinatown — Korea's only official Chinatown — and taste jajangmyeon (black bean noodles) at its birthplace. Walk to the colorful Songwol-dong Fairy Tale Village with its whimsical murals, and stroll through the historic Open Port area to experience Incheon's unique multicultural heritage.

experiences.name: Bupyeong Modoo Mall Underground Shopping & Korean BBQ Dinner
experiences.description: Explore Bupyeong's famous underground shopping mall, one of the largest in Korea, perfect for finding K-fashion, beauty products, and accessories at local prices. End the evening at a traditional Korean BBQ restaurant in the Bupyeong area, grilling samgyeopsal (pork belly) and galbi (short ribs) tableside with soju and banchan side dishes.
